$schema.description: The schema URI used by compatible editors. The schema published with this documentation is available at sing-box.sagernet.org/schema.json.

path.description: Path to the cache file. cache.db will be used if empty.

cache_id.description: Identifier in the cache file If not empty, configuration specified data will use a separate store keyed by it.

store_fakeip.description: Store fakeip in the cache file

store_rdrc.description: Store rejected DNS response cache in the cache file The check results of Legacy Address Filter Fields will be cached until expiration.

rdrc_timeout.description: Timeout of rejected DNS response cache. 7d is used by default.

store_dns.description: Store DNS cache in the cache file.

listen.description: gRPC API listening address. V2Ray API will be disabled if empty.

external_controller.description: RESTful web API listening address. Clash API will be disabled if empty.

external_ui.description: A relative path to the configuration directory or an absolute path to a directory in which you put some static web resource. sing-box will then serve it at http://{{external-controller}}/ui.

external_ui_download_url.description: ZIP download URL for the external UI, will be used if the specified externalui directory is empty. https://github.com/MetaCubeX/Yacd-meta/archive/gh-pages.zip will be used if empty.

external_ui_download_detour.description: The tag of the outbound to download the external UI. Default outbound will be used if empty.

secret.description: Secret for the RESTful API (optional) Authenticate by spedifying HTTP header Authorization: Bearer ${secret} ALWAYS set a secret if RESTful API is listening on 0.0.0.0

default_mode.description: Default mode in clash, Rule will be used if empty. This setting has no direct effect, but can be used in routing and DNS rules via the clashmode rule item.

access_control_allow_origin.description: CORS allowed origins,  will be used if empty. To access the Clash API on a private network from a public website, you must explicitly specify it in accesscontrolalloworigin instead of using .

access_control_allow_private_network.description: Allow access from private network. To access the Clash API on a private network from a public website, accesscontrolallowprivatenetwork must be enabled.

store_mode.description: Store Clash mode in cache file.

store_selected.description: Store selected outbound for the Selector outbound in cache file.

cache_file.description: Cache file path, cache.db will be used if empty.

cache_id.description: Identifier in cache file. If not empty, configuration specified data will use a separate store keyed by it.

path.description: The path to the sing-geosite database. geosite.db will be used if empty.

download_url.description: The download URL of the sing-geoip database. Default is https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-geosite/releases/latest/download/geosite.db.

download_detour.description: The tag of the outbound to download the database. Default outbound will be used if empty.

outbound.description: Tag of target outbound. If not specified, the rule only matches in pre-match from auto redirect, and will be skipped in other contexts.

method.description: For TCP and UDP connections: - default: Reply with TCP RST for TCP connections, and ICMP port unreachable for UDP packets. - drop: Drop packets. For ICMP echo requests: - default: Reply with ICMP host unreachable. - drop: Drop packets. - reply: Reply with ICMP echo reply.

no_drop.description: If not enabled, method will be temporarily overwritten to drop after 50 triggers in 30s. Not available when method is set to drop.

network_strategy.description: See Dial Fields for details. Only take effect if outbound is direct without outbound.bindinterface, outbound.inet4bindaddress and outbound.inet6bindaddress set.

udp_disable_domain_unmapping.description: If enabled, for UDP proxy requests addressed to a domain, the original packet address will be sent in the response instead of the mapped domain. This option is used for compatibility with clients that do not support receiving UDP packets with domain addresses, such as Surge.

udp_connect.description: If enabled, attempts to connect UDP connection to the destination instead of listen.

udp_timeout.description: Timeout for UDP connections. Setting a larger value than the UDP timeout in inbounds will have no effect. Default value for protocol sniffed connections: If no protocol is sniffed, the following ports will be recognized as protocols by default:

tls_fragment.description: Fragment TLS handshakes to bypass firewalls. This feature is intended to circumvent simple firewalls based on plaintext packet matching, and should not be used to circumvent real censorship. Due to poor performance, try tlsrecordfragment first, and only apply to server names known to be blocked. On Linux, Apple platforms, (administrator privileges required) Windows, the wait time can be automatically detected. Otherwise, it will fall back to waiting for a fixed time specified by tlsfragmentfallb

tls_fragment_fallback_delay.description: The fallback value used when TLS segmentation cannot automatically determine the wait time. 500ms is used by default.

tls_record_fragment.description: Fragment TLS handshake into multiple TLS records to bypass firewalls.

tls_spoof.description: Inject a forged TLS ClientHello carrying this SNI before the real one, to fool SNI-filtering middleboxes that permit specific hostnames. See outbound TLS spoof for details and required privileges.

tls_spoof_method.description: How the forged segment is rejected by the real server. See outbound TLS spoofmethod for the full table of accepted values and platform notes.

sniffer.description: Enabled sniffers. All sniffers enabled by default. Available protocol values an be found on in Protocol Sniff

timeout.description: Override the DNS query timeout for this lookup. Will override dns.timeout.

server.description: Specifies DNS server tag to use instead of selecting through DNS routing.

strategy.description: DNS resolution strategy, available values are: preferipv4, preferipv6, ipv4only, ipv6only. dns.strategy will be used by default.

disable_cache.description: Disable cache and save cache in this query.

disable_optimistic_cache.description: Disable optimistic DNS caching in this query.

client_subnet.description: Append a edns0-subnet OPT extra record with the specified IP prefix to every query by default. If value is an IP address instead of prefix, /32 or /128 will be appended automatically. Will override dns.clientsubnet.

auth_user.description: Username, see each inbound for details.

protocol.description: Sniffed protocol, see Protocol Sniff for details.

client.description: Sniffed client type, see Protocol Sniff for details.

network.description: Match network type. tcp, udp or icmp.

process_path_regex.description: Match process path using regular expression.

package_name_regex.description: Match android package name using regular expression.

network_type.description: Match network type. Available values: wifi, cellular, ethernet and other.

network_is_expensive.description: Match if network is considered Metered (on Android) or considered expensive, such as Cellular or a Personal Hotspot (on Apple platforms).

network_is_constrained.description: Match if network is in Low Data Mode.

network_interface_address.description: Matches network interface (same values as networktype) address.

wifi_ssid.description: Match WiFi SSID. See Wi-Fi State for details.

wifi_bssid.description: Match WiFi BSSID. See Wi-Fi State for details.

source_hostname.description: Match source device hostname from DHCP leases.

rule_set_ipcidr_match_source.description: Make ipcidr in rule-sets match the source IP.

rule_set_ip_cidr_match_source.description: Make ipcidr in rule-sets match the source IP.

path.description: The path to the sing-geoip database. geoip.db will be used if empty.

download_url.description: The download URL of the sing-geoip database. Default is https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-geoip/releases/latest/download/geoip.db.

download_detour.description: The tag of the outbound to download the database. Default outbound will be used if empty.

final.description: Default outbound tag. the first outbound will be used if empty.

auto_detect_interface.description: Bind outbound connections to the default NIC by default to prevent routing loops under tun. Takes no effect if outbound.bindinterface is set.

override_android_vpn.description: Accept Android VPN as upstream NIC when autodetectinterface enabled.

default_interface.description: Bind outbound connections to the specified NIC by default to prevent routing loops under tun. Takes no effect if autodetectinterface is set.

default_mark.description: Set routing mark by default. Takes no effect if outbound.routingmark is set.

find_process.description: Enable process search for logging when no processname, processpath, packagename, user or userid rules exist.

find_neighbor.description: Enable neighbor resolution for logging when no sourcemacaddress or sourcehostname rules exist. See Neighbor Resolution for setup.

dhcp_lease_files.description: Custom DHCP lease file paths for hostname and MAC address resolution. Automatically detected from common DHCP servers (dnsmasq, odhcpd, ISC dhcpd, Kea) if empty.

default_http_client.description: Tag of the default HTTP Client used by remote rule-sets. If empty and httpclients is defined, the first HTTP client is used.

default_domain_resolver.description: See Dial Fields for details. Can be overridden by outbound.domainresolver.

default_network_strategy.description: See Dial Fields for details. Takes no effect if outbound.bindinterface, outbound.inet4bindaddress or outbound.inet6bindaddress is set. Can be overridden by outbound.networkstrategy. Conflicts with defaultinterface.

store.description: The default X509 trusted CA certificate list.

certificate.description: The certificate line array to trust, in PEM format.

certificate_path.description: The paths to certificates to trust, in PEM format.

certificate_directory_path.description: The directory path to search for certificates to trust,in PEM format.

protocol.description: Multiplex protocol. h2mux is used by default.

min_streams.description: Minimum multiplexed streams in a connection before opening a new connection. Conflict with maxstreams.

max_streams.description: Maximum multiplexed streams in a connection before opening a new connection. Conflict with maxconnections and minstreams.

reject.description: Reject with TCP RST / ICMP unreachable. See reject for details.

route.description: Forward connections directly at L3 to the specified outbound, without going through L3 to L4 translation. Supported targets: - ICMP connections: Direct and Bridge outbounds, and WireGuard / Tailscale endpoints. - TCP and UDP connections: Bridge outbounds, and WireGuard / Tailscale endpoints. L3 forwarding also applies when no rule matches and the default outbound is a supported target; for outbound groups, the currently selected outbound is used. FakeIP destinations require a resolve action perf

sniff.description: For UDP connections, sniffing runs on the first packet and rule matching continues with the sniffed metadata. When sniffers require more data (like a fragmented QUIC Client Hello), pre-match stops at that rule. For TCP connections, pre-match always stops at that rule. See sniff for details.

bypass.description: Bypass sing-box and connect directly at kernel level. If outbound is not specified, the rule only matches in pre-match from auto redirect, and will be skipped in other contexts. For all other contexts, bypass with outbound behaves like route action. See bypass for details.

enabled.description: Enable TCP Brutal congestion control algorithm。

up_mbps, down_mbps.description: Upload and download bandwidth, in Mbps.

host.description: Host domain. The server will verify if not empty.

path.description: Path of HTTP request. The server will verify.

method.description: Method of HTTP request. The server will verify if not empty.

headers.description: Extra headers of HTTP request. The server will write in response if not empty.

idle_timeout.description: In standard gRPC server/client: If the transport doesn't see any activity after a duration of this time, it pings the client to check if the connection is still active. In default gRPC server/client: It has the same behavior as the corresponding setting in HTTP transport.

ping_timeout.description: In standard gRPC server/client: The timeout that after performing a keepalive check, the client will wait for activity. If no activity is detected, the connection will be closed. In default gRPC server/client: It has the same behavior as the corresponding setting in HTTP transport.

max_early_data.description: Allowed payload size is in the request. Enabled if not zero.

early_data_header_name.description: Early data is sent in path instead of header by default. To be compatible with Xray-core, set this to Sec-WebSocket-Protocol. It needs to be consistent with the server.

permit_without_stream.description: In standard gRPC client: If enabled, the client transport sends keepalive pings even with no active connections. If disabled, when there are no active connections, idletimeout and pingtimeout will be ignored and no keepalive pings will be sent. Disabled by default.

engine.description: TLS engine to use. Values:  go (default)  apple  windows Supported fields:  servername  insecure  alpn  minversion  maxversion  certificate / certificatepath  certificatepublickeysha256  handshaketimeout Unsupported fields:  disablesni  ciphersuites  curvepreferences  clientcertificate / clientcertificatepath / clientkey / clientkeypath  fragment / recordfragment  kerneltx / kernelrx  ech  utls  reality The default version range is TLS 1.2 to TLS 1.3, matching the go engine.

disable_sni.description: Do not send server name in ClientHello.

server_name.description: Used to verify the hostname on the returned certificates unless insecure is given. It is also included in the client's handshake to support virtual hosting unless it is an IP address.

alpn.description: List of supported application level protocols, in order of preference. If both peers support ALPN, the selected protocol will be one from this list, and the connection will fail if there is no mutually supported protocol. See Application-Layer Protocol Negotiation.

min_version.description: The minimum TLS version that is acceptable. TLS 1.2 is used by default.

max_version.description: The maximum TLS version that is acceptable. By default, the maximum version is currently TLS 1.3.

cipher_suites.description: List of enabled TLS 1.0–1.2 cipher suites. The order of the list is ignored. Note that TLS 1.3 cipher suites are not configurable. If empty, a safe default list is used. The default cipher suites might change over time.

curve_preferences.description: Set of supported key exchange mechanisms. The order of the list is ignored, and key exchange mechanisms are chosen from this list using an internal preference order by Golang. Available values, also the default list:  P256  P384  P521  X25519  X25519MLKEM768

certificate.description: Server certificates chain line array, in PEM format.

certificate_path.description: The path to server certificate chain, in PEM format.

certificate_public_key_sha256.description: List of SHA-256 hashes of server certificate public keys, in base64 format. To generate the SHA-256 hash for a certificate's public key, use the following commands:

client_certificate.description: Client certificate chain line array, in PEM format.

client_certificate_path.description: List of path to client certificate chain, in PEM format.

client_key.description: Client private key line array, in PEM format.

client_key_path.description: The path to client private key, in PEM format.

key.description: ECH key line array, in PEM format.

key_path.description: The path to ECH key, in PEM format.

client_authentication.description: The type of client authentication to use. Available values:  no (default)  request  require-any  verify-if-given  require-and-verify One of clientcertificate, clientcertificatepath, or clientcertificatepublickeysha256 is required if this option is set to verify-if-given, or require-and-verify.

client_certificate_public_key_sha256.description: List of SHA-256 hashes of client certificate public keys, in base64 format. To generate the SHA-256 hash for a certificate's public key, use the following commands:

handshake_timeout.description: TLS handshake timeout, in golang's Duration format. 15s is used by default.

certificate_provider.description: A string or an object. When string, the tag of a shared Certificate Provider. When object, an inline certificate provider. See Certificate Provider for available types and fields.

utls.description: uTLS is a fork of "crypto/tls", which provides ClientHello fingerprinting resistance. Available fingerprint values:  chrome  firefox  edge  safari  360  qq  ios  android  random  randomized Chrome fingerprint will be used if empty.

pq_signature_schemes_enabled.description: Enable support for post-quantum peer certificate signature schemes.

dynamic_record_sizing_disabled.description: Disables adaptive sizing of TLS records. When true, the largest possible TLS record size is always used. When false, the size of TLS records may be adjusted in an attempt to improve latency.

config.description: ECH configuration line array, in PEM format. If empty, load from DNS will be attempted.

config_path.description: The path to ECH configuration, in PEM format. If empty, load from DNS will be attempted.

query_server_name.description: Overrides the domain name used for ECH HTTPS record queries. If empty, servername is used for queries.

fragment.description: Fragment TLS handshakes to bypass firewalls. This feature is intended to circumvent simple firewalls based on plaintext packet matching, and should not be used to circumvent real censorship. Due to poor performance, try recordfragment first, and only apply to server names known to be blocked. On Linux, Apple platforms, (administrator privileges required) Windows, the wait time can be automatically detected. Otherwise, it will fall back to waiting for a fixed time specified by fragmentfallbackdel

fragment_fallback_delay.description: The fallback value used when TLS segmentation cannot automatically determine the wait time. 500ms is used by default.

record_fragment.description: Fragment TLS handshake into multiple TLS records to bypass firewalls.

spoof.description: Inject a forged TLS ClientHello carrying a whitelisted SNI before the real one, to fool SNI-filtering middleboxes that permit specific hostnames. Requires CAPNETRAW and CAPNETADMIN on Linux, root on macOS, and Administrator on Windows. Windows on ARM64 is not supported.

spoof_method.description: How the forged segment is rejected by the real server.

domain.description: List of domain. ACME will be disabled if empty.

data_directory.description: The directory to store ACME data. $XDGDATAHOME/certmagic|$HOME/.local/share/certmagic will be used if empty.

default_server_name.description: Server name to use when choosing a certificate if the ClientHello's ServerName field is empty.

email.description: The email address to use when creating or selecting an existing ACME server account

provider.description: The ACME CA provider to use.

alternative_http_port.description: The alternate port to use for the ACME HTTP challenge; if non-empty, this port will be used instead of 80 to spin up a listener for the HTTP challenge.

alternative_tls_port.description: The alternate port to use for the ACME TLS-ALPN challenge; the system must forward 443 to this port for challenge to succeed.

external_account.description: EAB (External Account Binding) contains information necessary to bind or map an ACME account to some other account known by the CA. External account bindings are "used to associate an ACME account with an existing account in a non-ACME system, such as a CA customer database. To enable ACME account binding, the CA operating the ACME server needs to provide the ACME client with a MAC key and a key identifier, using some mechanism outside of ACME. §7.3.4

dns01_challenge.description: ACME DNS01 challenge field. If configured, other challenge methods will be disabled. See DNS01 Challenge Fields for details.

handshake.description: Handshake server address and Dial Fields.

private_key.description: Private key, generated by sing-box generate reality-keypair.

public_key.description: Public key, generated by sing-box generate reality-keypair.

short_id.description: A hexadecimal string with zero to eight digits.

max_time_difference.description: The maximum time difference between the server and the client. Check disabled if empty.

udp_timeout.description: UDP NAT expiration time. 5m will be used by default.

udp_mapping.description: UDP NAT mapping behavior. endpointindependent is used by default.

udp_filtering.description: UDP NAT filtering behavior. endpointindependent is used by default.

udp_nat_max.description: Maximum number of UDP NAT sessions. When the limit is reached, the least recently used session is closed. When unset or set to 0, 4096 is used on iOS. On other platforms, a value from 4096 to 16384 is selected based on total memory; 16384 is used if total memory cannot be detected.

bind_interface.description: The network interface to bind to.

routing_mark.description: Set netfilter routing mark. Integers (e.g. 1234) and string hexadecimals (e.g. "0x1234") are supported.

netns.description: Set network namespace, name or path. Since sing-box 1.14.0, the tag of a network namespace can also be used.

tcp_keep_alive.description: TCP keep alive initial period. 5m will be used by default.

tcp_keep_alive_interval.description: TCP keep alive interval. 75s will be used by default.

udp_timeout.description: UDP NAT expiration time. 5m will be used by default.

detour.description: If set, connections will be forwarded to the specified inbound. Requires target inbound support, see Injectable.

sniff.description: Enable sniffing. See Protocol Sniff for details.

sniff_override_destination.description: Override the connection destination address with the sniffed domain. If the domain name is invalid (like tor), this will not work.

sniff_timeout.description: Timeout for sniffing. 300ms is used by default.

domain_strategy.description: One of preferipv4 preferipv6 ipv4only ipv6only. If set, the requested domain name will be resolved to IP before routing. If sniffoverridedestination is in effect, its value will be taken as a fallback.

udp_disable_domain_unmapping.description: If enabled, for UDP proxy requests addressed to a domain, the original packet address will be sent in the response instead of the mapped domain. This option is used for compatibility with clients that do not support receiving UDP packets with domain addresses, such as Surge.

detour.description: The tag of the upstream outbound. If enabled, all other fields will be ignored.

bind_interface.description: The network interface to bind to.

inet4_bind_address.description: The IPv4 address to bind to.

inet6_bind_address.description: The IPv6 address to bind to.

bind_address_no_port.description: Do not reserve a port when binding to a source address. This allows reusing the same source port for multiple connections if the full 4-tuple (source IP, source port, destination IP, destination port) remains unique.

routing_mark.description: Set netfilter routing mark. Integers (e.g. 1234) and string hexadecimals (e.g. "0x1234") are supported.

netns.description: Set network namespace, name or path. Since sing-box 1.14.0, the tag of a network namespace can also be used. Referencing an unshare network namespace should be avoided.

connect_timeout.description: Connect timeout, in golang's Duration format. A duration string is a possibly signed sequence of decimal numbers, each with optional fraction and a unit suffix, such as "300ms", "-1.5h" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "ns", "us" (or "µs"), "ms", "s", "m", "h".

tcp_keep_alive.description: TCP keep alive initial period. 5m will be used by default.

tcp_keep_alive_interval.description: TCP keep alive interval. 75s will be used by default.

domain_resolver.description: Set domain resolver to use for resolving domain names. This option uses the same format as the route DNS rule action without the action field. Setting this option directly to a string is equivalent to setting server of this options.

network_strategy.description: Strategy for selecting network interfaces. Available values: - default (default): Connect to default network or networks specified in networktype sequentially. - hybrid: Connect to all networks or networks specified in networktype concurrently. - fallback: Connect to default network or preferred networks specified in networktype concurrently, and try fallback networks when unavailable or timeout. For fallback, when preferred interfaces fails or times out, it will enter a 15s fast fallback state

network_type.description: Network types to use when using default or hybrid network strategy or preferred network types to use when using fallback network strategy. Available values: wifi, cellular, ethernet, other. Device's default network is used by default.

fallback_network_type.description: Fallback network types when preferred networks are unavailable or timeout when using fallback network strategy. All other networks expect preferred are used by default.

fallback_delay.description: The length of time to wait before spawning a RFC 6555 Fast Fallback connection. For domainstrategy, is the amount of time to wait for connection to succeed before assuming that IPv4/IPv6 is misconfigured and falling back to other type of addresses. For networkstrategy, is the amount of time to wait for connection to succeed before falling back to other interfaces. Only take effect when domainstrategy or networkstrategy is set. 300ms is used by default.

domain_strategy.description: Available values: preferipv4, preferipv6, ipv4only, ipv6only. If set, the requested domain name will be resolved to IP before connect.

engine.description: HTTP engine to use. Values:  go (default)  apple apple uses NSURLSession, only available on Apple platforms. Supported fields:  headers  tls.servername (must match request host)  tls.insecure  tls.minversion / tls.maxversion  tls.certificate / tls.certificatepath  tls.certificatepublickeysha256  Dial Fields Unsupported fields:  version  disableversionfallback  HTTP2 Fields  QUIC Fields  tls.engine  tls.alpn  tls.disablesni  tls.ciphersuites  tls.curvepreferences  tls.clientcertificate / tls.clie

version.description: HTTP version. Available values: 1, 2, 3. 2 is used by default. When 3, HTTP2 Fields are replaced by QUIC Fields.

disable_version_fallback.description: Disable automatic fallback to lower HTTP version.

headers.description: Custom HTTP headers. Host header is used as request host.

enabled.description: Enable the UDP over TCP protocol.

version.description: The protocol version, 1 or 2. 2 is used by default.

Protocol version 1.description: The client requests the magic address to the upper layer proxy protocol to indicate the request: sp.udp-over-tcp.arpa

Stream format.description: ATYP / address / port: Uses the SOCKS address format, but with different address types:

Protocol version 2.description: Protocol version 2 uses a new magic address: sp.v2.udp-over-tcp.arpa

idle_timeout.description: Idle connection timeout, in golang's Duration format.

keep_alive_period.description: Keep alive period, in golang's Duration format.

stream_receive_window.description: HTTP2 stream-level flow-control receive window size. Accepts memory size format, e.g. "64 MB".

connection_receive_window.description: HTTP2 connection-level flow-control receive window size. Accepts memory size format, e.g. "64 MB".

ttl.description: The TTL of the temporary TXT record used for the DNS challenge.

propagation_delay.description: How long to wait after creating the challenge record before starting propagation checks.

propagation_timeout.description: The maximum time to wait for the challenge record to propagate. Set to -1 to disable propagation checks.

resolvers.description: Preferred DNS resolvers to use for DNS propagation checks.

override_domain.description: Override the domain name used for the DNS challenge record. Useful when acme-challenge is delegated to a different zone.

provider.description: The DNS provider. See below for provider-specific fields.

version.description: Version of rule-set.  1: sing-box 1.8.0: Initial rule-set version.  2: sing-box 1.10.0: Optimized memory usages of domainsuffix rules in binary rule-sets.  3: sing-box 1.11.0: Added networktype, networkisexpensive and networkisconstrainted rule items.  4: sing-box 1.13.0: Added networkinterfaceaddress and defaultinterfaceaddress rule items.  5: sing-box 1.14.0: Added packagenameregex rule item.

type.description: Type of rule-set, local or remote.

format.description: Format of rule-set file, source or binary. Optional when path or url uses json or srs as extension.

initial_path.description: File path of the initial rule-set content. Used at startup when no cached rule-set is available.

http_client.description: HTTP Client for downloading rule-set. See HTTP Client Fields for details. When empty, the default HTTP client is used: the one named by defaulthttpclient, or the first top-level httpclients entry when defaulthttpclient is empty.

update_interval.description: Update interval of rule-set. 1d will be used if empty.

download_detour.description: Tag of the outbound to download rule-set.

query_type.description: DNS query type. Values can be integers or type name strings.

process_path_regex.description: Match process path using regular expression.

package_name_regex.description: Match android package name using regular expression.

network_type.description: Match network type. Available values: wifi, cellular, ethernet and other.

network_is_expensive.description: Match if network is considered Metered (on Android) or considered expensive, such as Cellular or a Personal Hotspot (on Apple platforms).

network_is_constrained.description: Match if network is in Low Data Mode.

network_interface_address.description: Matches network interface (same values as networktype) address.

server_port.description: NTP server port. 123 is used by default.

interval.description: Time synchronization interval. 30 minutes is used by default.

state_directory.description: The directory where the Tailscale state is stored. tailscale is used by default. Example: $HOME/.tailscale

auth_key.description: The auth key to create the node. If the node is already created (from state previously stored), then this field is not used.

control_url.description: The coordination server URL. https://controlplane.tailscale.com is used by default.

ephemeral.description: Indicates whether the instance should register as an Ephemeral node (https://tailscale.com/s/ephemeral-nodes).

hostname.description: The hostname of the node. System hostname is used by default. Example: localhost

accept_routes.description: Indicates whether the node should accept routes advertised by other nodes.

exit_node.description: The exit node name or IP address to use.

exit_node_allow_lan_access.description: Indicates whether locally accessible subnets should be routed directly or via the exit node.

advertise_routes.description: CIDR prefixes to advertise into the Tailscale network as reachable through the current node. Example: ["192.168.1.1/24"]

advertise_exit_node.description: Indicates whether the node should advertise itself as an exit node.

advertise_tags.description: Tags to advertise for this node, for ACL enforcement purposes. Example: ["tag:server"]

listen_port.description: The UDP port to listen on for WireGuard and peer-to-peer traffic. A port is automatically selected by default.

relay_server_port.description: The port to listen on for incoming relay connections from other Tailscale nodes.

relay_server_static_endpoints.description: Static endpoints to advertise for the relay server.

system_interface.description: Create a system TUN interface for Tailscale.

system_interface_name.description: Custom TUN interface name. By default, tailscale (or utun on macOS) will be used.

system_interface_mtu.description: Override the TUN MTU. By default, Tailscale's own MTU is used.

udp_timeout.description: UDP NAT expiration time. 5m will be used by default.

When enabled, the service tracks and saves comprehensive statistics including: - Request counts - Token usage (input, output, cached) - Calculated costs in USD based on OpenAI API pricing Statistics are organized by model and optionally by user when authentication is enabled. The statistics file is automatically saved every minute and upon service shutdown.

users.description: List of authorized users for token authentication. If empty, no authentication is required. Object format: Object fields: - name: Username identifier for tracking purposes. - token: Bearer token for authentication. Clients authenticate by setting the Authorization: Bearer <token> header.

headers.description: Custom HTTP headers to send to the OpenAI API. These headers will override any existing headers with the same name.

detour.description: Outbound tag for connecting to the OpenAI API.

tls.description: TLS configuration, see TLS. When configured, the realm serves HTTP/2 over TLS; otherwise plain HTTP/1.1.

users.name.description: Username, used in logs and as the quota key.

users.token.description: Bearer token presented by Hysteria2 inbounds and outbounds via Authorization: Bearer <token>.

users.max_realms.description: Maximum number of realm slots this user may hold concurrently.

action.description: The action to perform. route will be used by default.

race.description: Only available with route, respond, reject and predefined actions. Requires matchresponse (for logical rules, in sub-rules). Conflict with speculative. By default, rules are matched one after another in listed order: a rule with matchresponse waits for its referenced responses, and no later rule is matched until it has been judged. A rule with race enabled does not hold this order: rule matching continues past it while its referenced responses are still pending, so the matching of race rules run

speculative.description: Has no effect without a preceding race rule. By default, no query is sent in parallel with pending race rules: a matched evaluate action holds its query, and rule matching stops there, until none of the race rules matched. When speculative is enabled, the query is sent as soon as the rule matches, in parallel with the pending race rules, and rule matching continues without waiting for them.

strategy.description: Set domain strategy for this query. One of preferipv4 preferipv6 ipv4only ipv6only.

disable_cache.description: Disable cache and save cache in this query.

disable_optimistic_cache.description: Disable optimistic DNS caching in this query.

timeout.description: Override the DNS query timeout for matched queries. Will override dns.timeout.

client_subnet.description: Append a edns0-subnet OPT extra record with the specified IP prefix to every query by default. If value is an IP address instead of prefix, /32 or /128 will be appended automatically. Will override dns.clientsubnet.

remove_client_subnet.description: Remove the edns0-subnet OPT extra record from the query, and suppress dns.clientsubnet. Conflict with clientsubnet.

tag.description: Tag of the evaluated response. A tagged response is only referenced via matchresponse with the tag; matchresponse: true references the response of the latest evaluate action without tag.

method.description: - default: Reply with REFUSED. - drop: Drop the request. default will be used by default.

no_drop.description: If not enabled, method will be temporarily overwritten to drop after 50 triggers in 30s. Not available when method is set to drop.

rcode.description: The response code. NOERROR will be used by default.

answer.description: List of text DNS record to respond as answers. Examples:

ns.description: List of text DNS record to respond as name servers.

extra.description: List of text DNS record to respond as extra records.

ip_version.description: 4 (A DNS query) or 6 (AAAA DNS query). Not limited if empty.

query_type.description: DNS query type. Values can be integers or type name strings.

query_client_subnet.description: Match the edns0-subnet OPT extra record (EDNS Client Subnet) in the query. A listed prefix matches when it is no more specific than the received client subnet and contains its address. If value is an IP address instead of prefix, /32 or /128 will be appended automatically.

query_dnssec.description: Match queries with the DNSSEC OK (DO) bit set.

auth_user.description: Username, see each inbound for details.

protocol.description: Sniffed protocol, see Sniff for details.

process_path_regex.description: Match process path using regular expression.

package_name_regex.description: Match android package name using regular expression.

network_type.description: Match network type. Available values: wifi, cellular, ethernet and other.

network_is_expensive.description: Match if network is considered Metered (on Android) or considered expensive, such as Cellular or a Personal Hotspot (on Apple platforms).

network_is_constrained.description: Match if network is in Low Data Mode.

network_interface_address.description: Matches network interface (same values as networktype) address.

source_hostname.description: Match source device hostname from DHCP leases.

preferred_by.description: Match specified DNS servers' preferred domains.

rule_set_ip_cidr_match_source.description: Make ipcidr rule items in rule-sets match the source IP.

When enabled, this rule matches against the evaluated response (set by a preceding evaluate action) instead of only matching the original query. true or the tag of an evaluate action: true matches against the response of the latest evaluate action without tag; a tag matches against the response of the evaluate action with the tag. ip_accept_any.description: Match when the DNS query response contains at least one address.

outbound.description: Match outbound. any can be used as a value to match any outbound.

ip_cidr.description: Match IP CIDR with query response. As a Legacy Address Filter Field, deprecated. Use with matchresponse instead, check Migration.

ip_is_private.description: Match private IP with query response. As a Legacy Address Filter Field, deprecated. Use with matchresponse instead, check Migration.

rule_set_ip_cidr_accept_empty.description: Make ipcidr rules in rule-sets accept empty query response.

response_rcode.description: Match DNS response code. Accepted values are the same as in the predefined action rcode.

response_answer.description: Match DNS answer records. Record format is the same as in predefined action answer.

response_ns.description: Match DNS name server records. Record format is the same as in predefined action ns.

response_extra.description: Match DNS extra records. Record format is the same as in predefined action extra.

final.description: Default dns server tag. The first server will be used if empty.

disable_cache.description: Disable dns cache. Conflict with optimistic.

disable_expire.description: Disable dns cache expire. Conflict with optimistic.

independent_cache.description: Make each DNS server's cache independent for special purposes. If enabled, will slightly degrade performance.

cache_capacity.description: LRU cache capacity. Value less than 1024 will be ignored.

optimistic.description: Enable optimistic DNS caching. When a cached DNS entry has expired but is still within the timeout window, the stale response is returned immediately while a background refresh is triggered. Conflict with disablecache and disableexpire. Accepts a boolean or an object. When set to true, the default timeout of 3d is used.

timeout.description: Default timeout for each DNS query. 10s is used by default. Can be overridden by rules.[].timeout (DNS rule action) or domainresolver.timeout.

reverse_mapping.description: Stores a reverse mapping of IP addresses after responding to a DNS query in order to provide domain names when routing. pid_file.description: If set, the PID of the process holding the namespace open is written to this path. The namespace can be entered with nsenter -t <pid> -n when sing-box is run as root, or nsenter -t <pid> -U --preserve-credentials -n otherwise.

alternative_http_port.description: The alternate port to use for the ACME HTTP challenge; if non-empty, this port will be used instead of 80 to spin up a listener for the HTTP challenge.

request_type.description: The signature type to request from Cloudflare. origin-rsa is used if empty.

netns.description: Set network namespace, name or path. Since sing-box 1.14.0, the tag of a network namespace can also be used. Referencing an unshare network namespace should be avoided.

tcp_keep_alive.description: TCP keep alive initial period. 5m will be used by default.

tcp_keep_alive_interval.description: TCP keep alive interval. 75s will be used by default.

sniff.description: Enable sniffing. See Protocol Sniff for details.

sniff_override_destination.description: Override the connection destination address with the sniffed domain. If the domain name is invalid (like tor), this will not work.

sniff_timeout.description: Timeout for sniffing. 300ms is used by default.

domain_strategy.description: Available values: preferipv4, preferipv6, ipv4only, ipv6only. If set, the requested domain name will be resolved to IP before connect.

udp_disable_domain_unmapping.description: If enabled, for UDP proxy requests addressed to a domain, the original packet address will be sent in the response instead of the mapped domain. This option is used for compatibility with clients that do not support receiving UDP packets with domain addresses, such as Surge.

inet4_bind_address.description: The IPv4 address to bind to.

inet6_bind_address.description: The IPv6 address to bind to.

bind_address_no_port.description: Do not reserve a port when binding to a source address. This allows reusing the same source port for multiple connections if the full 4-tuple (source IP, source port, destination IP, destination port) remains unique.

connect_timeout.description: Connect timeout, in golang's Duration format. A duration string is a possibly signed sequence of decimal numbers, each with optional fraction and a unit suffix, such as "300ms", "-1.5h" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "ns", "us" (or "µs"), "ms", "s", "m", "h".

domain_resolver.description: Set domain resolver to use for resolving domain names. This option uses the same format as the route DNS rule action without the action field. Setting this option directly to a string is equivalent to setting server of this options.

network_strategy.description: Strategy for selecting network interfaces. Available values: - default (default): Connect to default network or networks specified in networktype sequentially. - hybrid: Connect to all networks or networks specified in networktype concurrently. - fallback: Connect to default network or preferred networks specified in networktype concurrently, and try fallback networks when unavailable or timeout. For fallback, when preferred interfaces fails or times out, it will enter a 15s fast fallback state

network_type.description: Network types to use when using default or hybrid network strategy or preferred network types to use when using fallback network strategy. Available values: wifi, cellular, ethernet, other. Device's default network is used by default.

fallback_network_type.description: Fallback network types when preferred networks are unavailable or timeout when using fallback network strategy. All other networks expect preferred are used by default.

fallback_delay.description: The length of time to wait before spawning a RFC 6555 Fast Fallback connection. For domainstrategy, is the amount of time to wait for connection to succeed before assuming that IPv4/IPv6 is misconfigured and falling back to other type of addresses. For networkstrategy, is the amount of time to wait for connection to succeed before falling back to other interfaces. Only take effect when domainstrategy or networkstrategy is set. 300ms is used by default.

udp_mapping.description: UDP NAT mapping behavior. endpointindependent is used by default.

udp_filtering.description: UDP NAT filtering behavior. endpointindependent is used by default.

udp_nat_max.description: Maximum number of UDP NAT sessions. When the limit is reached, the least recently used session is closed. When unset or set to 0, 4096 is used on iOS. On other platforms, a value from 4096 to 16384 is selected based on total memory; 16384 is used if total memory cannot be detected.

disable_sni.description: Do not send server name in ClientHello.

alpn.description: List of supported application level protocols, in order of preference. If both peers support ALPN, the selected protocol will be one from this list, and the connection will fail if there is no mutually supported protocol. See Application-Layer Protocol Negotiation.

min_version.description: The minimum TLS version that is acceptable. TLS 1.2 is used by default.

max_version.description: The maximum TLS version that is acceptable. By default, the maximum version is currently TLS 1.3.

cipher_suites.description: List of enabled TLS 1.0–1.2 cipher suites. The order of the list is ignored. Note that TLS 1.3 cipher suites are not configurable. If empty, a safe default list is used. The default cipher suites might change over time.

curve_preferences.description: Set of supported key exchange mechanisms. The order of the list is ignored, and key exchange mechanisms are chosen from this list using an internal preference order by Golang. Available values, also the default list:  P256  P384  P521  X25519  X25519MLKEM768

utls.description: uTLS is a fork of "crypto/tls", which provides ClientHello fingerprinting resistance. Available fingerprint values:  chrome  firefox  edge  safari  360  qq  ios  android  random  randomized Chrome fingerprint will be used if empty.

pq_signature_schemes_enabled.description: Enable support for post-quantum peer certificate signature schemes.

query_server_name.description: Overrides the domain name used for ECH HTTPS record queries. If empty, servername is used for queries.
